local View = {}

local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent
	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder
	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100
	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder
	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end
	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2,
			math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), width or 0.14,
			math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5)
	end
	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a, b = index * math.pi / 6, (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(x + math.cos(a) * radius, y + math.sin(a) * radius,
				x + math.cos(b) * radius, y + math.sin(b) * radius, width or 0.12)
		end
	end
	local function ticket()
		bar(0.18, 0.2, 0.82, 0.2)
		bar(0.18, 0.8, 0.82, 0.8)
		bar(0.18, 0.2, 0.18, 0.36)
		bar(0.18, 0.64, 0.18, 0.8)
		bar(0.82, 0.2, 0.82, 0.36)
		bar(0.82, 0.64, 0.82, 0.8)
		for index = 0, 2 do shape(0.62, 0.32 + index * 0.18, 0.07, 0.09, 0, 0.3) end
		bar(0.29, 0.4, 0.41, 0.5, 0.09)
		bar(0.41, 0.5, 0.29, 0.6, 0.09)
	end
	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" or role == "plus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and 45 or 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and -45 or 90, 0.5)
	elseif role == "minus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.85, 0.15, 0, 0.5)
	elseif role == "back" or role == "chevron" then
		local edge, point = 0.68, 0.32
		if role == "chevron" then edge, point = 0.32, 0.68 end
		bar(edge, 0.16, point, 0.5)
		bar(point, 0.5, edge, 0.84)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33,
				0.26, 0.16, math.deg(angle), 0.3)
		end
	elseif role == "codes" then
		ticket()
	elseif role == "shop" or role == "inventory" or role == "lock" then
		ring(0.5, 0.32, 0.2, 0.12)
		shape(0.5, 0.66, 0.72, 0.54, 0, 0.12)
	elseif role == "gift" then
		shape(0.5, 0.65, 0.76, 0.58, 0, 0.09)
		shape(0.5, 0.32, 0.92, 0.16, 0, 0.2)
		ring(0.35, 0.16, 0.1, 0.09)
		ring(0.65, 0.16, 0.1, 0.09)
	elseif role == "home" then
		bar(0.1, 0.46, 0.5, 0.12)
		bar(0.5, 0.12, 0.9, 0.46)
		bar(0.24, 0.42, 0.24, 0.85)
		bar(0.76, 0.42, 0.76, 0.85)
		bar(0.24, 0.85, 0.76, 0.85)
	elseif role == "currency" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.38, 0.12)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.15, 0.43, 0, 0.4)
	elseif role == "profile" then
		shape(0.5, 0.25, 0.38, 0.38, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.75, 0.8, 0.4, 0, 0.5)
	elseif role == "search" then
		ring(0.41, 0.4, 0.28, 0.13)
		bar(0.63, 0.63, 0.89, 0.89, 0.15)
	elseif role == "quest" then
		bar(0.22, 0.54, 0.43, 0.75, 0.16)
		bar(0.43, 0.75, 0.82, 0.23, 0.16)
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end
	return holder
end

function View.build()

	bgFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bgFrame.Parent = screenGui

	bgClouds.Name = "BackgroundSkyClouds"
	bgClouds.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bgClouds.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bgClouds.Image = "nexusasset://asset_02d3c8eba7a4481db446147a12db63df"
	bgClouds.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	bgClouds.ImageTransparency = 0.25
	bgClouds.Parent = bgFrame

	-- Atmospheric subtle gradient overlay
	local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, COLOR_BG),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, COLOR_SURFACE),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, COLOR_BG)
	})
	bgGrad.Rotation = 45

	---------------------------------------------------------

	---------------------------------------------------------

		createNexusIcon(btnSettings, "settings", {

		-- Secondary CREDITS button

		btnCredits.Name = "BtnCredits"

	---------------------------------------------------------

	---------------------------------------------------------

	-- Music Toggle Row
	local toggleMusic = Instance.new("TextButton")
	toggleMusic.Name = "ToggleMusic"

	local musicRowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	musicRowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

	local musicRowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

	local musicLeft = Instance.new("Frame")
	musicLeft.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0)

	local mLeftLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	mLeftLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	mLeftLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	mLeftLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
	mLeftLayout.Parent = musicLeft

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local root = script.Parent
local modulesFolder = root:FindFirstChild("_NexusSource") or root

local Responsive = require(modulesFolder:WaitForChild("Runtime"):WaitForChild("Responsive"))
local ButtonEffects = require(modulesFolder:WaitForChild("Runtime"):WaitForChild("ButtonEffects"))

-- Bind viewport responsiveness across _NexusDesktop / _NexusMobile
Responsive.bind(root)

-- Color definitions for state updates
local COLOR_TEAL = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 216)
local COLOR_MUTED_BG = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 75)

-- State
local musicEnabled = true
local soundEnabled = true

-- Modal References
local modalLayer = root:FindFirstChild("ModalLayer", true)
local modalBackdrop = modalLayer and modalLayer:FindFirstChild("ModalBackdrop")
local panelSettings = modalLayer and modalLayer:FindFirstChild("PanelSettings")
local panelCredits = modalLayer and modalLayer:FindFirstChild("PanelCredits")

local function openModal(targetPanel)
	if not modalBackdrop or not targetPanel then return end
	modalBackdrop.Visible = true
	targetPanel.Visible = true

	local scale = targetPanel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Parent = targetPanel
	end
	scale.Scale = 0.85

	modalBackdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	TweenService:Create(modalBackdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	}):Play()

	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Scale = 1
	}):Play()
end

local function closeModal()
	if not modalBackdrop then return end

	TweenService:Create(modalBackdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	}):Play()

	for _, panel in ipairs({panelSettings, panelCredits}) do
		if panel and panel.Visible then
			local scale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if scale then
				local tw = TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
					Scale = 0.85
				})
				tw:Play()
				tw.Completed:Connect(function()
					panel.Visible = false
				end)
			else
				panel.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	task.delay(0.18, function()
		modalBackdrop.Visible = false
	end)
end

if modalBackdrop then
	modalBackdrop.Activated:Connect(closeModal)
end

-- Helper to update toggle switch visuals
local function updateToggleVisual(toggleBtn, state)
	if not toggleBtn then return end
	local pill = toggleBtn:FindFirstChild("PillSwitch")
	if not pill then return end
	local knob = pill:FindFirstChild("Knob")
	if not knob then return end

	local targetPillColor = state and COLOR_TEAL or COLOR_MUTED_BG
	local targetKnobPos = state and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)

	TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		BackgroundColor3 = targetPillColor
	}):Play()

	TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetKnobPos
	}):Play()
end

-- Wire interactions to descendants
for _, node in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
	if node:IsA("GuiButton") and node.Name ~= "ModalBackdrop" then
		ButtonEffects.bind(node, {
			hoverScale = 1.04,
			pressScale = 0.96,
			duration = 0.12
		})

		if node.Name == "BtnPlay" then
			node.Activated:Connect(function()
				print("[SKYBOUND] Starting Game...")
			end)
		elseif node.Name == "BtnSettings" then
			node.Activated:Connect(function()
				openModal(panelSettings)
			end)
		elseif node.Name == "BtnCredits" then
			node.Activated:Connect(function()
				openModal(panelCredits)
			end)
		elseif node.Name == "BtnCloseSettings" or node.Name == "BtnCloseCredits" then
			node.Activated:Connect(closeModal)
		elseif node.Name == "ToggleMusic" then
			node.Activated:Connect(function()
				musicEnabled = not musicEnabled
				updateToggleVisual(node, musicEnabled)
			end)
		elseif node.Name == "ToggleSound" then
			node.Activated:Connect(function()
				soundEnabled = not soundEnabled
				updateToggleVisual(node, soundEnabled)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback

designMemory.originalUserGoal: Create a polished main menu for a Roblox adventure game called SKYBOUND. Use a cohesive sky-island adventure style with a deep navy background, warm ivory typography, teal accents, and restrained gold highlights. Include a strong game title, a primary Play button, and secondary Settings and Credits buttons. Add a small version label. Make the composition feel distinctive and premium, with clear visual hierarchy, generous spacing, consistent icons, subtle hover/press feedback, and smooth menu transitions. Settings should open a panel with music and sound toggles, and Credits should open a dismissible panel. Support desktop and mobile with readable text and comfortable touch targets. Generate the UI and preview so I can rate the result.

composition.alignmentSystem: Left-aligned dominant vertical stack on desktop with anchored bottom-left version badge; centered modal windows with semi-transparent overlay backdrop managed by explicit View-Controller state transitions.

iconSystem.styleDescription: Clean geometric vector icons featuring sharp adventure-style edges, uniform line weights, high contrast ivory/cyan fills, and subtle outer drop shadow.

motionSystem.hover: Smooth scale 1.0 to 1.04 with 180ms cubic-bezier transition, surface highlight fill alpha modulation

motionSystem.entrance: Main hero & buttons slide in from left (offset -40px) with fade-in over 350ms quad-out; modals scale up 0.9x to 1.0x with background dim transition over 250ms
motionSystem.release: Return to hover or default resting state over 150ms
motionSystem.reducedMotion: Disable spatial displacement animations; replace with simple 100ms fade/opacity state changes
motionSystem.touchBehavior: Instant visual press feedback upon touch down; trigger action on TouchEnded inside boundary without synthetic hover stickiness

audioSystem.touchBehavior: Suppress hover sounds on touch inputs; debounce click audio by 150ms to prevent rapid activation spam
audioSystem.fallbackBehavior: Silent operation without throwing script execution errors if audio asset failed to preload

responsiveStrategy.desktop: Left-aligned spacious linear stack for title and main CTA buttons, preserving right screen area for dramatic 3D sky island view; modals open as centered crisp framed cards.
responsiveStrategy.mobile: Reflow title and navigation to center column with wider touch targets (minimum 48-54px height); modals consume up to 84% screen width with clear dismiss tap targets.
responsiveStrategy.tablet: Balanced left-central alignment with enlarged text scale, retaining full 3D viewport exposure.

implementationNotes: Build main frame structure with `_NexusDesktop` and `_NexusMobile` canonical groups for layout preview switching.

Harmonized icon attributes (size 18px, medium weight, smooth edge, no shadow) across all settings modal content elements in `group_settings_content`.
Reduced UI audio volume to 0.20 and increased debounce interval to 150ms to ensure feedback sounds remain subtle and non-intrusive.
Ensure Settings and Credits modals maintain `Visible = false` on initial view load, activating with background overlay dim (`Transparency = 0.4`) when triggered.

issues.description: A large, semi-transparent 'ROBLOX' watermark severely overlaps the primary 'PLAY GAME' button, secondary navigation buttons ('SETTINGS', 'CREDITS'), and partially obscures the 'SKYBOUND' title. This artifact renders the UI unusable and completely breaks the intended composition, hierarchy, and readability.

The 'ROBLOX' watermark persists on the mobile layout, overlapping critical interactive elements ('PLAY GAME', 'SETTINGS', 'CREDITS') and the main title. This makes the UI unreadable and unresponsive, failing to provide a functional mobile experience.

The 'ROBLOX' watermark is also present and highly disruptive on the tablet viewport, obscuring the main navigation buttons and title. This issue is consistent across all device previews, indicating a fundamental problem with the UI capture or rendering.
The presence of the 'ROBLOX' watermark severely detracts from any polish or premium feel the UI might otherwise convey, making the entire interface appear unfinished and unprofessional.
The watermark makes the UI unsuitable for a Roblox game, as it directly interferes with player interaction and readability of essential menu elements.

criticalIssues: The 'ROBLOX' watermark is present across all provided UI previews (desktop, phone, tablet), critically overlapping and obscuring the main title and all primary/secondary navigation buttons. This renders the UI unusable, unpolished, and completely unsuitable for a game. This is a fundamental issue that must be resolved before any further design evaluation can be meaningful.

Ensure that UI captures or rendering processes do not introduce any unintended overlays or watermarks.
Re-render and resubmit the UI previews without the watermark for a proper design evaluation.
